title: Campus Day Rates for Observation Placed Through the Emergency Department — Hospital Account (Encounter Billing)
content:
The campus day rate applies to observation placed through the emergency department on a self-pay Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account and depends on the account's facility.

**Clause.** On an account carrying an emergency department level charge line (revenue code 0450), Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton (the tertiary campus) adds 250.00 dollars per day to the observation day rate, and Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton (the critical-access campus) adds -250.00 dollars per day, which lowers the day rate by 250.00 for each day. Any other campus, or a stay with no such line (a direct or post-procedure placement), adds none.

| Facility | Emergency department level line (0450) on the account | Change to the observation day rate, per day |
|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton | yes | 250.00 added |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | yes | -250.00 added (lower by 250.00) |
| Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah | yes | none |
| Riverbend Surgery & Imaging Center - Grand Chute | yes | none |
| any campus | no (direct or post-procedure placement) | none |

*Case (hypothetical).* A Chilton observation stay that began in the emergency department carries a level line, so its day rate is 250.00 lower for every observation day; the same stay placed directly from a clinic carries no level line and its day rate is unchanged.
